algorithm_basis: Python 3 stdlib only: secp256k1 point math, BIP-32 master/child derivation, BIP-341 TapLeaf/TapBranch/TapTweak, BIP-350 bech32m, Bitcoin descriptor checksum, canonical script-number push encoding (OP_0 / OP_1..OP_16 / minimal length-prefixed bytes). No repository Go code and no btcd involved.
seed_material: each signer seed is a single byte repeated 32 times; recovery key is the /0/0 x-only child of its seed's master
usage: recorded constants are cross-checked at test run time against the test-local independent calculator; they are external-drift detectors, never the sole expected value
